When budgeting for a Da Nang beachfront villa, add taxes, transaction fees, furnishing costs and annual operating costs. For resale units, personal income tax of 2% of the transfer price (paid by the seller by law) and the 0.5% registration fee (paid by the buyer) are the two largest items – for example, for a 30 billion VND villa, the registration fee is about 150 million VND and personal income tax about 600 million VND if the parties agree the buyer pays.
